title: Book Two · Chapter 42: A Line on the Ground
story:
Leo comes to the green gate on Sunday afternoon. He has the soft ball and a short piece of chalk.

“Are you free?” he asks.

Ronan looks toward Dad's work board. The brown box is there. The drawer is inside it now. Dad is reading his own work note.

“We can go to the little square,” Mum says. “I need a walk.”

She puts her sewing away. Ronan takes his water bottle. The boys walk beside her, with the ball in Leo's hands.

At the square, Leo draws a line on the ground. The ball must bounce before the line. The other boy must catch it after the line.

Ronan throws too far. Leo catches the ball, but it does not touch the ground.

“No bounce,” Leo says.

“You caught it.”

“That is only half the job.”

Leo throws it back. This time it hits the ground twice.

“Two bounces,” Ronan says.

“An extra one. Free.”

They laugh. Mum sits on the low wall and opens her water bottle.

After a few turns, the boys stop beside her. Leo rolls the chalk between his fingers.

“Miss Wu will talk to us tomorrow,” he says.

“About the kite page.”

Leo nods. “I nearly missed blue.”

“On the brother's line?”

“Yes. At first I put the colours the other way round. Then I went back.”

“Did you change your answer?”

“Yes. Before I gave her the page.”

Ronan drinks some water. He wrote the brother for his second answer. He is still sure about that one.

“Did you finish all three?” Leo asks.

“Yes.”

“Are they right?”

“I think so.”

Leo nods. He asks no more questions. He wants the ball back. Ronan closes his bottle and gives it to Mum.

They start again. The ground slopes a little near one corner. A ball keeps rolling toward the wall there.

Ronan points to the flatter part.

“Let's turn the game this way.”

Leo draws a second line. Ronan rubs the old line away with his shoe. Now the ball comes toward the open space.

Jun passes the square with his mother. He stops for a short turn. Leo throws. The ball hits the new line exactly.

“Before or after?” Jun asks.

“On,” Ronan says.

“That is a new place.”

Jun's mother calls him from the corner. He gives the ball back and waves. He cannot stay for another game.

Ronan and Leo try to hit the chalk line on purpose. They miss it four times. On the next throw, the ball lands in the same small spot.

Both boys shout at once. Mum puts one finger to her ear.

“I saw it,” she says. “The whole street can hear it, too.”

On the way home, Ronan carries the ball. Leo has the chalk. They draw a tiny dot on a scrap to mark their best throw.

At the gate, Dad comes out with a clean cloth over the box.

“Monday morning,” he says. “Ready to go back to the counter.”

“Ready for the woman?” Ronan asks.

“Not that promise yet.”

Leo waits while Ronan puts the ball away. They agree to walk to school together in the morning.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

bounce＝弹起；blue＝蓝色的；answer＝答案；again＝再次。

## 理解问题

1. Leo怎样谈到自己在练习中的漏读？
2. 两人后来怎样修改球的路线？

## 读句子

**Leo / draws / a second line.** Leo／画出／第二条线。
